_comment: WORKFLOW-DEFINITION-DRIFT-1 (issue #1669). Canonical source of truth for live qnfo-audit fleet_tasks.definition values. The D1 table fleet_tasks_canonical is seeded from this file and a drift-gate fleet_task (fleet-tasks-drift-gate) files an agent_issue whenever the live definition differs from the canonical copy. Regenerated 2026-10-18 by chatbox-agent (ROADMAP-BACKLOG-SYNC-1 closeout) from qnfo-audit.

bench-arc-battery.definition:
{"model":"@cf/meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct-fp8-fast","prompt":"You are solving ARC (Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus) tasks. For each of 5 tasks, infer the transformation rule from the example input-output pair, then apply it to the test input. Answer as a JSON object with keys t1..t5; each value is the output grid as a single string of integers in row-major order separated by spaces. No explanations.
t1 (fill entire grid with the single colored cell's color): example input '1 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 0' output '1 1 1 / 1 1 1 / 1 1 1'. test input '0 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 7'.
t2 (mirror the grid left-right): example input '1 0 0 / 2 0 0 / 3 0 0' output '0 0 1 / 0 0 2 / 0 0 3'. test input '7 0 0 / 8 0 0 / 9 0 0'.
t3 (replace every 2 with 3): example input '1 1 2 / 1 2 2 / 2 2 2' output '1 1 3 / 1 3 3 / 3 3 3'. test input '2 2 1 / 2 1 1 / 1 1 1'.
t4 (count colored cells, output an N by N grid filled with N): example input '0 1 0 / 0 1 0 / 0 0 0' output '2 2 / 2 2'. test input '1 0 0 / 0 1 0 / 0 0 1'.
t5 (rotate the grid 90 degrees clockwise): example input '1 2 3 / 4 5 6 / 7 8 9' output '7 4 1 / 8 5 2 / 9 6 3'. test input '1 0 0 / 0 0 0 / 0 0 0'.","max_tokens":400}

cost-roi-gate.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE roi_daily_snapshots SET ai_cost_usd = (SELECT ROUND(spent_usd/30.0,4) FROM model_ladder_budget WHERE month=strftime('%Y-%m','now')) WHERE d=date('now')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT spent_usd, blocked, (SELECT ROUND(ai_cost_usd*1000.0/NULLIF(pageviews,0),3) FROM roi_daily_snapshots WHERE d=date('now')) AS cost_per_1k_reach FROM model_ladder_budget WHERE month=strftime('%Y-%m','now')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE model_ladder_budget SET blocked = CASE WHEN spent_usd > 200 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHERE month=strftime('%Y-%m','now')"}]}

deferred-drain.definition:
{"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status IN ('dispatched','detected')) AS open_heals,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status='resolved') AS resolved,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status='no-action') AS noaction,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='proposed') AS proposed,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='approved') AS approved"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE self_heal_actions SET status='resolved', verified_at=datetime('now')
    WHERE kind='fleet-issue' AND status IN ('dispatched','detected','no-action')
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_issue_loop L WHERE L.fingerprint=self_heal_actions.ref AND L.gh_state='cleared')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE self_heal_actions SET status='escalated', verified_at=datetime('now')
    WHERE status='detected' AND kind='content-signal-alert'"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='approved', updated_at=datetime('now')
    WHERE status='proposed'"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE self_heal_actions SET status='no-action', verified_at=datetime('now')
    WHERE status IN ('detected','dispatched') AND ts < datetime('now','-14 days')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='withdrawn', updated_at=datetime('now')
    WHERE status='proposed' AND created_at < datetime('now','-30 days')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status IN ('dispatched','detected')) AS open_heals_after,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status='resolved') AS resolved_after,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions WHERE status='no-action') AS noaction_after,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='proposed') AS proposed_after,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='approved') AS approved_after"}]}

fi-executor.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT id, kind, title, priority FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='approved' ORDER BY CASE priority WHEN 'P1' THEN 0 WHEN 'P2' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, id LIMIT 20"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='queued', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE status='approved' AND priority='P1'"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='in_progress', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE status='queued' AND priority='P1' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_improvements ip WHERE ip.title=fleet_improvements.title AND ip.status='in_progress')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='queued', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE status='approved' AND priority='P2'"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='in_progress', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE status='queued' AND priority='P2' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='in_progress' AND priority='P1')=0"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'IMPROVEMENT-TERMINAL-DISPOSITION: '||title, 'fi-executor CLOSED-LOOP-DISPOSITION-1: improvement #'||id||' ('||kind||', target '||target||') exceeded the in_progress SLA with no terminal action; re-scoped to an owned agent_issue. Detail: '||COALESCE(detail,''), 'fi-executor','remediation', CASE priority WHEN 'P1' THEN 'high' WHEN 'P2' THEN 'medium' ELSE 'low' END, 'open', CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='in_progress' AND updated_at < datetime('now','-7 day') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title='IMPROVEMENT-TERMINAL-DISPOSITION: '||fleet_improvements.title AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_improvements SET status='resolved', evidence=COALESCE(evidence,'')||' | fi-executor terminal disposition: re-scoped to owned agent_issue (<=7d in_progress SLA breach)', updated_at=datetime('now') WHERE status='in_progress' AND updated_at < datetime('now','-7 day')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='approved') approved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='queued') queued, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_improvements WHERE status='in_progress') in_progress"}]}

fleet-tasks-drift-gate.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'WORKFLOW-DEFINITION-DRIFT: ' || t.id, 'AUTO-FILED by fleet-tasks-drift-gate (issue 1669). Live fleet_tasks.definition for ' || t.id || ' (version ' || t.version || ') differs from the canonical repo export ' || COALESCE(c.repo_path,'?') || ' seeded in fleet_tasks_canonical. The live row was edited out-of-band with no repo source, which is how the self-audit broken correlated reference shipped unnoticed. Remediate by either restoring the canonical definition or updating docs/fleet-tasks-canonical.json AND fleet_tasks_canonical in the same change.', 'fleet-tasks-drift-gate','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM fleet_tasks t JOIN fleet_tasks_canonical c ON c.id = t.id WHERE t.definition <> c.definition AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'WORKFLOW-DEFINITION-DRIFT: ' || t.id AND a.status='open')"}]}

issue-dispatch-drain.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT COUNT(*) AS orphaned FROM fleet_issue_dispatch WHERE state = 'queued' AND exec_state IS NULL"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE fleet_issue_dispatch SET exec_state = 'blocked-no-worker-handler', exec_ts = datetime('now'), exec_attempts = COALESCE(exec_attempts,0)+1, exec_result = 'issue-dispatch-drain: action type has no SQL-executor handler (chain-produce/cron-trigger need a worker op); dispositioned and escalated to owner' WHERE state = 'queued' AND exec_state IS NULL"}]}

metric-refresh.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'open_agent_issues' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues WHERE status='open') AS TEXT) WHEN 'worker_count' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry) AS TEXT) WHEN 'deploy_freshness_h' THEN CAST(CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM worker_live_audit WHERE probed_at >= datetime('now','-26 hours')) = 0 THEN ROUND((julianday('now')-julianday((SELECT MAX(ts) FROM fleet_deploys WHERE ok = 1 AND COALESCE(note,'') NOT LIKE 'SETTINGS-ONLY%')))*24,2) ELSE COALESCE((SELECT ROUND(MAX(julianday('now') - julianday(COALESCE((SELECT MAX(d.ts) FROM fleet_deploys d WHERE d.worker = a.worker AND d.ok = 1 AND COALESCE(d.note,'') NOT LIKE 'SETTINGS-ONLY%'), a.probed_at)))*24,2) FROM worker_live_audit a WHERE a.note LIKE '%DRIFT%'), 0) END AS TEXT) WHEN 'probe_coverage_pct' THEN CAST(ROUND(100.0*(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT name) FROM fleet_probe_log WHERE ts > datetime('now','-24 hours') AND name IN (SELECT service FROM service_registry))/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry),1) AS TEXT) WHEN 'zenodo_downloads_total' THEN CAST((SELECT SUM(downloads) FROM zenodo_stats) AS TEXT) WHEN 'zenodo_views_total' THEN CAST((SELECT SUM(views) FROM zenodo_stats) AS TEXT) WHEN 'distribution_posts_30d' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_media_posts WHERE created_at > datetime('now','-30 days')) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM social_threads WHERE status='posted' AND posted_at > datetime('now','-30 days')) AS TEXT) WHEN 'cron_compliance' THEN CAST(ROUND(100.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_crons WHERE enabled=1 AND last_fired IS NOT NULL)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fleet_crons WHERE enabled=1),1) AS TEXT) WHEN 'subscribers_growth_monthly' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscribers WHERE status='subscribed' AND COALESCE(confirmed_at, created_at) > datetime('now','-30 days') AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@qnfo.org' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@qnfo.net' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@qnfo.uk' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@q08.org' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@qwav.%' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@q-wave.tech' AND lower(email) NOT LIKE '%@qwave.tech') AS TEXT) WHEN 'external_impact_per_dollar' THEN CAST(ROUND(CAST((SELECT last_value FROM metric_registry WHERE metric='cost_usd_30d') AS REAL) / (CAST((SELECT last_value FROM metric_registry WHERE metric='pageviews_30d') AS REAL) + CAST((SELECT last_value FROM metric_registry WHERE metric='zenodo_views_total') AS REAL) + 100.0*(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscribers)), 5) AS TEXT) END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now'), state = 'OK' WHERE metric IN ('open_agent_issues','worker_count','deploy_freshness_h','probe_coverage_pct','zenodo_downloads_total','zenodo_views_total','distribution_posts_30d','cron_compliance','subscribers_growth_monthly','external_impact_per_dollar')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CAST(CAST((SELECT MIN(COALESCE(v,1)) FROM (SELECT (SELECT MAX(c2.value) FROM citation_stats c2 WHERE c2.doi = d.doi AND c2.source='zenodo' AND c2.metric='versions' AND c2.collected_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-3 days')) AS v FROM (SELECT doi, MAX(value) AS dl FROM citation_stats WHERE source='zenodo' AND metric='downloads' AND collected_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-3 days') GROUP BY doi ORDER BY dl DESC LIMIT 10) d)) AS INTEGER) AS TEXT), last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now'), state = 'OK', formula = 'min(Zenodo versions) over the 10 most-downloaded papers (flagships); versions = relations.version index+1 recorded by qnfo-paper-indexer in citation_stats metric=versions; a flagship with no versions row counts as 1' WHERE metric = 'zenodo_versions_per_flagship' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM citation_stats WHERE source='zenodo' AND metric='versions' AND collected_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-3 days')) > 0"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'session_execution_ratio_30d' THEN COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(AVG(execution_ratio), 2) FROM session_records WHERE execution_ratio IS NOT NULL AND created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 days')) AS TEXT), 'n/a') ELSE CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM session_records WHERE created_at >= datetime('now', '-30 days')) AS TEXT) END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), state = 'MEASURED' WHERE metric IN ('session_execution_ratio_30d', 'session_records_30d')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'metrics_in_breach' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_metric_trigger_state WHERE hit = 1) AS TEXT) WHEN 'metric_trigger_coverage_pct' THEN CAST(ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metric_registry r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM analytics_metric_triggers t WHERE t.enabled = 1 AND t.metric_key = r.metric)) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metric_registry), 1) AS TEXT) WHEN 'remedy_efficacy_30d' THEN COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(AVG(o), 2) FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN s.hit = 0 THEN 1.0 WHEN s.hit = 1 THEN 0.0 END AS o FROM analytics_action_log a JOIN v_metric_trigger_state s ON s.id = a.trigger_id WHERE a.fired_at >= datetime('now', '-30 days') AND a.fired_at < datetime('now', '-7 days') AND a.status IN ('dispatched', 'deduped') UNION ALL SELECT CASE e.decision WHEN 'kept' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS o FROM perf_experiments e WHERE e.decision IN ('kept', 'reverted') AND e.decided_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-30 days'))) AS TEXT), 'n/a') WHEN 'fleet_cmd_answer_rate_7d' THEN COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(status = 'answered') / NULLIF(SUM(status IN ('answered', 'failed')), 0), 2) FROM cmd_log WHERE kind = 'ai' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')) AS TEXT), 'n/a') ELSE CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cmd_log WHERE kind = 'action' AND status = 'done' AND ts >= datetime('now', '-7 days')) AS TEXT) END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), state = 'MEASURED' WHERE metric IN ('metrics_in_breach', 'metric_trigger_coverage_pct', 'remedy_efficacy_30d', 'fleet_cmd_answer_rate_7d', 'fleet_cmd_owner_actions_7d')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'code_tasks_30d' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM code_tasks WHERE created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-30 days')) AS TEXT) WHEN 'code_task_success_rate_30d' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN CAST(ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'merged' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS TEXT) ELSE 'n/a: under 3 finished code tasks in 30d' END FROM code_tasks WHERE status IN ('merged', 'needs_human', 'closed', 'failed') AND created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-30 days')) WHEN 'code_task_superseded_share_30d' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 3 THEN CAST(ROUND(1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'closed' AND (merge_state = 'superseded' OR lower(COALESCE(merge_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(last_error, '')) LIKE '%supersed%' OR lower(COALESCE(merge_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(last_error, '')) LIKE '%stale base%' OR lower(COALESCE(merge_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(last_error, '')) LIKE '%conflicts with main%' OR lower(COALESCE(merge_note, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(last_error, '')) LIKE '%already shipped%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS TEXT) ELSE 'n/a: under 3 finished code tasks in 30d' END FROM code_tasks WHERE status IN ('merged', 'needs_human', 'closed', 'failed') AND created_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now', '-30 days')) WHEN 'breach_code_task_pct' THEN (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN CAST(ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN instr(t.action, char(10) || 'code-task:') > 0 OR t.action LIKE 'code-task:%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 1) AS TEXT) ELSE 'n/a: no trigger in breach' END FROM v_metric_trigger_state s JOIN analytics_metric_triggers t ON t.id = s.id WHERE s.hit = 1) ELSE last_value END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), state = 'MEASURED' WHERE metric IN ('code_tasks_30d', 'code_task_success_rate_30d', 'breach_code_task_pct', 'code_task_superseded_share_30d')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'issue_wontfix_share_7d' THEN COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'wontfix') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM agent_issues WHERE status IN ('closed', 'resolved', 'wontfix', 'duplicate') AND updated_at >= (strftime('%s', 'now') - 7 * 86400) * 1000) AS TEXT), 'n/a') ELSE COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(r.pass) / COUNT(*), 1) FROM (SELECT MAX(id) AS mid FROM remediation_verifications WHERE replace(substr(verified_at, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') >= datetime('now', '-7 days') GROUP BY COALESCE(CAST(issue_id AS TEXT), class)) g JOIN remediation_verifications r ON r.id = g.mid) AS TEXT), 'n/a') END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), state = 'MEASURED' WHERE metric IN ('issue_wontfix_share_7d', 'remediation_latest_pass_pct_7d')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE metric_registry SET last_value = CASE metric WHEN 'autonomous_fixes_30d' THEN CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM code_tasks WHERE goal LIKE '[issue #%' AND merged_by = 'qnfo-fleet-control' AND merge_state = 'verified' AND merged_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-30 days')) AS TEXT) ELSE COALESCE(CAST((SELECT ROUND(1.0 * SUM(outcome = 'queued') / NULLIF(SUM(outcome <> 'refused'), 0), 2) FROM issue_plans WHERE planned_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now', '-30 days')) AS TEXT), 'n/a') END, last_refreshed = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', 'now'), state = 'MEASURED' WHERE metric IN osf-staleness-watch.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status) SELECT 'watch-osf-stall-' || strftime('%Y%m%d%H'), datetime('now'), 'proactive-alert', 'WATCH:osf-check-stall: osf_check_log has no row in 2h despite the hourly cron; invocations are canceled mid-I/O before the unconditional INSERT', NULL, 'osf-staleness-watch', 'err' WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM osf_check_log WHERE checked_at > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-2 hours')) = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events WHERE kind='proactive-alert' AND text LIKE 'WATCH:osf-check-stall%' AND ts > datetime('now','-3 hours'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status) SELECT 'watch-deps-empty-' || strftime('%Y%m%d%H'), datetime('now'), 'proactive-alert', 'WATCH:registry-deps-empty: ' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry WHERE kind='worker' AND (deps IS NULL OR deps='' OR deps='[]')) || ' worker rows lost declared deps', NULL, 'osf-staleness-watch', 'warn' WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry WHERE kind='worker' AND (deps IS NULL OR deps='' OR deps='[]')) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cloud_ops_events WHERE kind='proactive-alert' AND text LIKE 'WATCH:registry-deps-empty%' AND ts > datetime('now','-3 hours'))"}]}

outreach-lane-watch.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status='pending') AS pending, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status='needs-contact') AS needs_contact, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status NOT IN ('sent','skipped')) AS nonterminal, (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status NOT IN ('sent','skipped')) AS newest_nonterminal"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title, description, source, category, priority, status, created_at, updated_at) SELECT 'OUTREACH-LANE-INERT-1: outreach_queue holds non-terminal rows with no status transition', 'AUTO-FILED by outreach-lane-watch (OUTREACH-LANE-WATCH-1). The outreach lane holds non-terminal rows whose newest created_at is older than 72h, so no consumer is advancing them. Owner: qnfo-outreach. Known contributing defect: agent_issues 1296 OUTREACH-ENRICHER-MISS-1 (33 percent false-negative on author-email extraction) parks rows that should be sendable. Deduped while an open copy exists.', 'outreach-lane-watch', 'remediation', 'high', 'open', CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000, CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status NOT IN ('sent','skipped')) > 0 AND (SELECT MAX(created_at) FROM outreach_queue WHERE status NOT IN ('sent','skipped')) < datetime('now','-72 hours') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'OUTREACH-LANE-INERT-1: outreach_queue holds non-terminal rows with no status transition' AND a.status = 'open')"}]}

recurrence-guard.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: agent_issues timestamp units non-ms re-violated','RECURRENCE GUARD (issue 1297 required fix b). Verified predicate re-violated: at least one agent_issues row stores created_at or updated_at below 1e11 (epoch-seconds). Refiled automatically by fleet task recurrence-guard.','recurrence-guard','remediation','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues WHERE created_at < 100000000000 OR (typeof(updated_at)='integer' AND updated_at < 100000000000)) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues WHERE title='RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: agent_issues timestamp units non-ms re-violated' AND status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: self_heal_actions stuck-dispatched re-violated','RECURRENCE GUARD (issue 1297 required fix b). Verified predicate re-violated: self_heal_actions rows remain status=dispatched with verified_at IS NULL while the matching fleet_issue_dispatch rows reached closed. Refiled automatically by fleet task recurrence-guard.','recurrence-guard','remediation','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM self_heal_actions s WHERE s.status='dispatched' AND s.verified_at IS NULL AND s.ts < strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now','-2 hours') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fleet_issue_dispatch f WHERE f.fingerprint = s.ref AND f.state IN ('closed','done'))) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues WHERE title='RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: self_heal_actions stuck-dispatched re-violated' AND status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: open agent_issues without issue_triage row re-violated','RECURRENCE GUARD (issue 1297 required fix b). Verified predicate re-violated: v_triage_gap > 0, i.e. open agent_issues carry no owner/SLA triage row. Refiled automatically by fleet task recurrence-guard.','recurrence-guard','remediation','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v_triage_gap WHERE title NOT LIKE 'RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1:%') > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues WHERE title='RECURRENCE-REVIOLATION-1: open agent_issues without issue_triage row re-violated' AND status='open')"}]}

removal-ledger-gate.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'REMOVAL-UNRECORDED: ' || w.worker, 'AUTO-FILED by removal-ledger-gate (issue 1668). Worker ' || w.worker || ' is ABSENT-BUT-PREVIOUSLY-SEEN: worker_live_audit note=' || w.note || ' (http ' || COALESCE(w.http,0) || ', probed ' || COALESCE(w.probed_at,'?') || ') and it has deploy history, but NO REMOVE row in deployment_history. A removal with no recorded actor/ts/reason is indistinguishable from accidental deletion - which is exactly what stalled remediation of issues 1639/1640/1654/1661. Remediate by adding a deployment_history row (action=REMOVE, actor, ts, reason, evidence) or by redeploying the worker.', 'removal-ledger-gate','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM worker_live_audit w WHERE w.note='NOT_DEPLOYED' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deployment_history d WHERE d.resource_name=w.worker AND d.action != 'REMOVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deployment_history r WHERE r.resource_name=w.worker AND r.action='REMOVE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title='REMOVAL-UNRECORDED: ' || w.worker AND a.status='open')"}]}

report-card-weekly.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO cloud_ops_events (id, ts, kind, text, meta, job, status) SELECT 'report-card-regen-' || strftime('%Y%m%d','now'), datetime('now'), 'report-card', 'report-card: weekly regeneration due (cloud trigger)', NULL, 'report-card-weekly', 'ok'"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO report_card_history (ts, signals_json) SELECT strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ','now'), '{\"source\":\"cloud-weekly-cron-trigger\",\"user_wait\":' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task_dod_register WHERE owner='user' AND status NOT IN ('done','cancelled','cancelled-with-monitor')) || ',\"open_issues\":' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_issues WHERE status NOT IN ('closed','done','resolved','wontfix','cancelled')) || ',\"unversioned\":' || (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM service_registry WHERE version IS NULL OR version='') || '}'"}]}

roadmap-backlog-sync.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO roadmap_implementation (item, source, title, artifact_type, artifact_ref, status, evidence, created_at) SELECT 'AI-'||id, 'agent_issues', substr(COALESCE(title,'issue '||id),1,200), CASE category WHEN 'security' THEN 'security' WHEN 'integrity' THEN 'governance' WHEN 'automation' THEN 'autonomy' WHEN 'cost' THEN 'cost' WHEN 'observability' THEN 'observability' WHEN 'governance' THEN 'governance' WHEN 'research' THEN 'research' WHEN 'outreach' THEN 'impact' WHEN 'web' THEN 'web' ELSE 'core' END, CAST(id AS TEXT), 'open', 'auto-tracked open '||COALESCE(priority,'?')||' '||COALESCE(category,'?')||' issue #'||id, datetime('now') FROM agent_issues WHERE status='open' AND COALESCE(priority,'') IN ('critical','high') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roadmap_implementation r WHERE r.item='AI-'||agent_issues.id)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE roadmap_implementation SET status='verified', verified_at=datetime('now'), evidence='auto: underlying agent issue closed' WHERE item LIKE 'AI-%' AND status<>'verified' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE CAST(a.id AS TEXT)=substr(roadmap_implementation.item,4) AND a.status<>'open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO roadmap_implementation (item, source, title, artifact_type, artifact_ref, status, evidence, created_at) SELECT 'FM-'||fm_key, 'failure_modes', substr(failure_mode,1,200), 'gate', fm_key, 'open', 'auto: failure mode '||fm_key||' ('||COALESCE(probe_class,'?')||')', datetime('now') FROM failure_modes WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM roadmap_implementation r WHERE r.item='FM-'||failure_modes.fm_key) AND (issue_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues i WHERE i.id=failure_modes.issue_id AND i.status='open'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE roadmap_implementation SET status='verified', verified_at=datetime('now'), evidence='auto: failure-mode FROM agent_issues i WHERE i.id=f.issue_id AND i.status<>'open'))"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO roadmap_implementation (item, source, title, artifact_type, artifact_ref, status, r.item='GL-'||goals.goal_key)"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"UPDATE roadmap_implementation SET status='verified', verified_at=datetime('now'), evidence='auto: goal completed/retired' WHERE item self-audit-systemwide.definition: {"steps":[{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-TOOLERR: ' || text, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide (SELF-AUDIT-SYSTEMWIDE-1). 24h tool error-rate breach for tool ' || text || ': ' || SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) || ' errors out of ' || COUNT(*) || ' calls. Classify as agent misuse vs tool defect before fixing.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','medium','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM tool_error_rate_24h WHERE ts > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z','now','-24 hours') GROUP BY text HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 AND 1.0*SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*) > 0.15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN status='error' AND ts > strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.000Z','now','-2 hours') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-TOOLERR: ' || tool_error_rate_24h.text AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-CRONSTALE: ' || name, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide (SELF-AUDIT-SYSTEMWIDE-1). Sub-daily cron ' || name || ' (task_id ' || task_id || ', expr ' || cron_expr || ') last fired ' || COALESCE(last_fired,'never') || ', which is older than 3h, or the cron has never fired since it was created. This predicate covers the DISPATCH-FIRER-MISSING class (a declared schedule with no firer). Check cron_fire_log and the owning worker trigger.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM fleet_crons WHERE enabled=1 AND (cron_expr='0 * * * *' OR cron_expr LIKE '*/%') AND ((last_fired IS NOT NULL AND julianday('now') - julianday(replace(last_fired,'T',' ')) > 0.125) OR (last_fired IS NULL AND julianday('now') - julianday(updated_at) > 0.125)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-CRONSTALE: ' || fleet_crons.name AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-NULLTS: agent_issues timestamp regression', 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide. ' || COUNT(*) || ' agent_issues rows have NULL created_at or updated_at. Regression of DEFAULT-TS-1 (agent_issues_created_at_default_ins / agent_issues_updated_at_default_ins, fixed 2026-09-29). NULL timestamps break recency ordering, SLA math and the self-audit staleness predicates.', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM agent_issues WHERE created_at IS NULL OR updated_at IS NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-NULLTS: agent_issues timestamp regression' AND a.status='open')"},{"type":"sql","db":"AUDIT","sql":"INSERT INTO agent_issues (title,description,source,category,priority,status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT 'SELF-AUDIT-TRIGGERMISSING: ' || j.value, 'AUTO-FILED by self-audit-systemwide. Critical guard trigger ' || j.value || ' is ABSENT from qnfo-audit. Without it the invariant it enforces silently stops being enforced (the class that let unclassified noise tickets file and let close-without-evidence writes through).', 'self-audit-systemwide','self-heal','high','open',CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000,CAST(strftime('%s','now') AS INTEGER)*1000 FROM json_each('[\"agent_issues_created_at_default_ins\",\"agent_issues_updated_at_default_ins\",\"issue_close_evidence_required\",\"agent_issues_autotriage2_ins\",\"agent_issues_normalise_tick\",\"agent_issues_recheck_count_upd\"]') j WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master s WHERE s.type='trigger' AND s.name = j.value) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM agent_issues a WHERE a.title = 'SELF-AUDIT-TRIGGERMISSING: ' || j.value AND a.status='open')"}]}
